description: factory-signing: before a Bash call that creates commits (git commit, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, am, and the factory CLI's state-changing commands in remote mode) in a repository that requires signed commits, denies it when SSH signing is not usable (no key, the key not in the ssh-agent, gpg.format not ssh) or when the command turns signing off. Otherwise prints nothing. It never rewrites a command, and any failure of its own, or running past the timeout, allows.
